Reset one sync's state. At least one level flag is required.

## Usage

```bash
drt state reset [OPTIONS] SYNC_NAME
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SYNC_NAME` | yes | Sync whose state to reset. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--watermark` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Clear the stored watermark. |
| `--runs` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Clear recorded run state. |
| `--tracked-mirror` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Re-baseline the destination's _drt_synced_keys (see the warning). |
| `--dry-run` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Report without changing anything. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
